scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
other_conditions: The applicant must be an Ex‑Serviceman.
The applicant must be disabled after retirement from service.
Disability percentage must be 50 % or more.
The applicant must not be covered under a similar scheme of the Army/Navy/Air Force.
The application must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB).
The applicant must be capable of personally utilizing the mobility equipment provided.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 for mobility equipment, with re‑application allowed after 10 years.
